evidence_items.explanation: The statement cites deposition and expert evidence for the scale of the LibGen download. Together with the training admission, it supports substantial unauthorized appropriation; the precise count remains the plaintiffs' evidentiary presentation.

OpenAI disputes the legal characterization of unlicensed training and also describes publisher partnerships elsewhere on this page. Its position prevents treating absence of permission alone as a settled infringement finding, but does not deny every instance of unlicensed use.
